First, we write the given expression as:

$$
\begin{aligned}{tan}^{2}⁡\theta \,{csc}^{2}⁡\theta -\frac{1}{{cot}^{2}⁡\theta } & ={tan}^{2}⁡\theta \,{csc}^{2}⁡\theta -{tan}^{2}⁡\theta \end{aligned}
$$

Now, we factor out ${tan}^{2}⁡\theta $ and use the identity 
${csc}^{2}⁡\theta -1={cot}^{2}⁡\theta .$
This gives

$$
\begin{aligned}{tan}^{2}⁡\theta \,{csc}^{2}⁡\theta -{tan}^{2}⁡\theta  & ={tan}^{2}⁡\theta \,({csc}^{2}⁡\theta -1) \\  & ={tan}^{2}⁡\theta \,{cot}^{2}⁡\theta  \\  & ={tan}^{2}⁡\theta \cdot \frac{1}{{tan}^{2}⁡\theta } \\  & =1.\end{aligned}
$$
